WorkspaceFileEvent.description: One debounced external file change under a project root.

contentHash.description: sha256 of the file content after the change; None for removals or unreadable/racing reads (best-effort, never blocks notification).

description: Broadcast to all connections; one per debounce window per project.

invalidatedChangesets.description: Pending changesets whose base hashes were contradicted by this event batch; clients should prompt re-index/re-create.

overflow.description: True when the debounce window held more events than the cap.

title: WorkspaceChangedNotification
